verses.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ πλήρης Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ὑπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ ἤγετο ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: Iēsous de plērēs Pneumatos Hagiou hypestrepsen apo tou Iordanou kai ēgeto en tō Pneumati en tē erēmō
verses.literal: Then Jesus full of the Holy Spirit returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
verses.literalPt: E JESUS, cheio do Espírito Santo, voltou do Jordão e foi levado pelo Espírito ao deserto;

verses.original: ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου Καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ συντελεσθεισῶν αὐτῶν ἐπείνασεν
verses.transliteration: hēmeras tesserakonta peirazomenos hypo tou diabolou Kai ouk ephagen ouden en tais hēmerais ekeinais kai syntelestheisōn autōn epeinasen
verses.literal: where for forty days He was tempted by the devil He ate nothing during those days and when they had ended He was hungry
verses.literalPt: E quarenta dias foi tentado pelo diabo, e naqueles dias não comeu coisa alguma; e, terminados eles, teve fome.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰπὲ τῷ λίθῳ τούτῳ ἵνα γένηται ἄρτος
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autō ho diabolos Ei Huios ei tou Theou eipe tō lithō toutō hina genētai artos
verses.literal: The devil said to Him If You are the Son of God tell this stone to become bread
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o diabo: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, dize a esta pedra que se transforme em pão.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἐπ’ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος
verses.transliteration: Kai apekrithē pros auton ho Iēsous Gegraptai hoti Ouk ep’ artō monō zēsetai ho anthrōpos
verses.literal: But Jesus answered - It is written - Man shall not live on bread alone
verses.literalPt: E Jesus lhe respondeu, dizendo: Está escrito que nem só de pão viverá o homem, mas de toda a palavra de Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναγαγὼν αὐτὸν ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν στιγμῇ χρόνου
verses.transliteration: Kai anagagōn auton edeixen autō pasas tas basileias tēs oikoumenēs en stigmē chronou
verses.literal: Then the devil led Him up to a high place . . . and showed Him in an instant . . . all the kingdoms of the world
verses.literalPt: E o diabo, levando-o a um alto monte, mostrou-lhe num momento de tempo todos os reinos do mundo.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος Σοὶ δώσω τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἅπασαν καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐμοὶ παραδέδοται καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν θέλω δίδωμι αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autō ho diabolos Soi dōsō tēn exousian tautēn hapasan kai tēn doxan autōn hoti emoi paradedotai kai hō ean thelō didōmi autēn
verses.literal: I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory - he said For it has been relinquished to me and I can give it to anyone . . . I wish
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o diabo: Dar-te-ei a ti todo este poder e a sua glória; porque a mim me foi entregue, e dou-o a quem quero.

verses.original: σὺ οὖν ἐὰν προσκυνήσῃς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἔσται σοῦ πᾶσα
verses.transliteration: sy oun ean proskynēsēs enōpion emou estai sou pasa
verses.literal: So if You worship . . . me it will all be Yours
verses.literalPt: Portanto, se tu me adorares, tudo será teu.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Γέγραπται Προσκυνήσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen autō Gegraptai Proskynēseis Kyrion ton Theon sou kai autō monō latreuseis
verses.literal: But Jesus answered . . . . . . It is written Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhe: Vai-te para trás de mim, Satanás; porque está escrito: Adorarás o Senhor teu Deus, e só a ele servirás.

verses.original: Ἤγαγεν δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ βάλε σεαυτὸν ἐντεῦθεν κάτω
verses.transliteration: Ēgagen de auton eis Ierousalēm kai estēsen epi to pterygion tou hierou kai eipen autō Ei Huios ei tou Theou bale seauton enteuthen katō
verses.literal: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple If You are the Son of God he said throw Yourself down from here
verses.literalPt: Levou-o também a Jerusalém, e pô-lo sobre o pináculo do templo, e disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, lança-te daqui abaixo;

verses.original: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε
verses.transliteration: gegraptai gar hoti Tois angelois autou enteleitai peri sou tou diaphylaxai se
verses.literal: For it is written He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque está escrito: Mandará aos seus anjos, acerca de ti, que te guardem,

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε μή‿ ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου
verses.transliteration: kai hoti epi cheirōn arousin se mē pote proskopsēs pros lithon ton poda sou
verses.literal: and they will lift You up in their hands so that You will not . . . strike Your foot against a stone
verses.literalPt: E que te sustenham nas mãos, Para que nunca tropeces com o teu pé em alguma pedra.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Εἴρηται Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis eipen autō ho Iēsous hoti Eirētai Ouk ekpeiraseis Kyrion ton Theon sou
verses.literal: But Jesus answered . . . . . . It also says Do not put the Lord your God to the test
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhe: Dito está: Não tentarás ao Senhor teu Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ συντελέσας πάντα πειρασμὸν ὁ διάβολος ἀπέστη ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἄχρι καιροῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai syntelesas panta peirasmon ho diabolos apestē ap’ autou achri kairou
verses.literal: When the devil had finished every temptation he left . . . Him until an opportune time
verses.literalPt: E, acabando o diabo toda a tentação, ausentou-se dele por algum tempo.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Πνεύματος εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ φήμη ἐξῆλθεν καθ’ ὅλης τῆς περιχώρου περὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hypestrepsen ho Iēsous en tē dynamei tou Pneumatos eis tēn Galilaian kai phēmē exēlthen kath’ holēs tēs perichōrou peri autou
verses.literal: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit and the news about Him spread throughout . . . the surrounding region
verses.literalPt: Então, pela virtude do Espírito, voltou Jesus para a Galiléia, e a sua fama correu por todas as terras em derredor.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδίδασκεν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν δοξαζόμενος ὑπὸ πάντων
verses.transliteration: kai autos edidasken en tais synagōgais autōn doxazomenos hypo pantōn
verses.literal: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone
verses.literalPt: E ensinava nas suas sinagogas, e por todos era louvado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρά οὗ ἦν τεθραμμένος καὶ εἰσῆλθεν κατὰ τὸ εἰωθὸς αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν καὶ ἀνέστη ἀναγνῶναι
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthen eis Nazara hou ēn tethrammenos kai eisēlthen kata to eiōthos autō en tē hēmera tōn sabbatōn eis tēn synagōgēn kai anestē anagnōnai
verses.literal: Then Jesus came to Nazareth where He had been brought up As was His custom He entered . . . the synagogue on the Sabbath . . . And when He stood up to read
verses.literalPt: E, chegando a Nazaré, onde fora criado, entrou num dia de sábado, segundo o seu costume, na sinagoga, e levantou-se para ler.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπεδόθη αὐτῷ βιβλίον τοῦ προφήτου Ἠσαΐου καὶ ἀναπτύξας τὸ βιβλίον εὗρεν τὸν τόπον οὗ ἦν γεγραμμένον
verses.transliteration: kai epedothē autō biblion tou prophētou Ēsaiou kai anaptyxas to biblion heuren ton topon hou ēn gegrammenon
verses.literal: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him Unrolling it He found the place where it was written
verses.literalPt: E foi-lhe dado o livro do profeta Isaías; e, quando abriu o livro, achou o lugar em que estava escrito:

verses.original: Πνεῦμα Κυρίου ἐπ’ ἐμέ Οὗ εἵνεκεν ἔχρισέν με Εὐαγγελίσασθαι πτωχοῖς Ἀπέσταλκέν με κηρῦξαι αἰχμαλώτοις ἄφεσιν Καὶ τυφλοῖς ἀνάβλεψιν Ἀποστεῖλαι τεθραυσμένους ἐν ἀφέσει
verses.transliteration: Pneuma Kyriou ep’ eme Hou heineken echrisen me Euangelisasthai ptōchois Apestalken me kēryxai aichmalōtois aphesin Kai typhlois anablepsin Aposteilai tethrausmenous en aphesei
verses.literal: The Spirit of the Lord is on Me because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind to release . . . . . . the oppressed
verses.literalPt: O Espírito do Senhor é sobre mim, Pois que me ungiu para evangelizar os pobres. Enviou-me a curar os quebrantados do coração,

verses.original: Κηρῦξαι ἐνιαυτὸν Κυρίου δεκτόν
verses.transliteration: Kēryxai eniauton Kyriou dekton
verses.literal: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor
verses.literalPt: A pregar liberdade aos cativos, E restauração da vista aos cegos, A pôr em liberdade os oprimidos, A anunciar o ano aceitável do SENHOR.

verses.original: Καὶ πτύξας τὸ βιβλίον ἀποδοὺς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ ἐκάθισεν καὶ πάντων οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦσαν ἀτενίζοντες αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ptyxas to biblion apodous tō hypēretē ekathisen kai pantōn hoi ophthalmoi en tē synagōgē ēsan atenizontes autō
verses.literal: Then He rolled up the scroll returned it to the attendant and sat down The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him
verses.literalPt: E, cerrando o livro, e tornando-o a dar ao ministro, assentou-se; e os olhos de todos na sinagoga estavam fitos nele.

verses.original: ἤρξατο δὲ λέγειν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Σήμερον πεπλήρωται ἡ γραφὴ αὕτη ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ērxato de legein pros autous hoti Sēmeron peplērōtai hē graphē hautē en tois ōsin hymōn
verses.literal: and He began by saying - Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing
verses.literalPt: Então começou a dizer-lhes: Hoje se cumpriu esta Escritura em vossos ouvidos.

verses.original: Καὶ πάντες ἐμαρτύρουν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις τῆς χάριτος τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχὶ υἱός ἐστιν Ἰωσὴφ οὗτος
verses.transliteration: Kai pantes emartyroun autō kai ethaumazon epi tois logois tēs charitos tois ekporeuomenois ek tou stomatos autou kai elegon Ouchi huios estin Iōsēph houtos
verses.literal: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips Isn’t . . . this the son of Joseph they asked
verses.literalPt: E todos lhe davam testemunho, e se maravilhavam das palavras de graça que saíam da sua boca; e diziam: Não é este o filho de José?

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Πάντως ἐρεῖτέ μοι τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην Ἰατρέ θεράπευσον σεαυτόν ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν γενόμενα εἰς τὴν Καφαρναοὺμ ποίησον καὶ ὧδε ἐν τῇ πατρίδι σου
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen pros autous Pantōs ereite moi tēn parabolēn tautēn Iatre therapeuson seauton hosa ēkousamen genomena eis tēn Kapharnaoum poiēson kai hōde en tē patridi sou
verses.literal: Jesus said to them Surely you will quote this proverb to Me Physician heal yourself Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Sem dúvida me direis este provérbio: Médico, cura-te a ti mesmo; faze também aqui na tua pátria tudo que ouvimos ter sido feito em Cafarnaum.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δέ Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς προφήτης δεκτός ἐστιν ἐν τῇ πατρίδι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de Amēn legō hymin hoti oudeis prophētēs dektos estin en tē patridi autou
verses.literal: Then He added Truly I tell you no prophet is accepted in his hometown
verses.literalPt: E disse: Em verdade vos digo que nenhum profeta é bem recebido na sua pátria.

verses.original: ἐπ’ ἀληθείας δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν πολλαὶ χῆραι ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἠλίου ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ ὅτε ἐκλείσθη ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπὶ ἔτη τρία καὶ μῆνας ἕξ ὡς ἐγένετο λιμὸς μέγας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: ep’ alētheias de legō hymin pollai chērai ēsan en tais hēmerais Ēliou en tō Israēl hote ekleisthē ho ouranos epi etē tria kai mēnas hex hōs egeneto limos megas epi pasan tēn gēn
verses.literal: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah when the sky was shut for three and a half . . . years and great famine swept over all the land
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que muitas viúvas existiam em Israel nos dias de Elias, quando o céu se cerrou por três anos e seis meses, de sorte que em toda a terra houve grande fome;

verses.original: καὶ πρὸς οὐδεμίαν αὐτῶν ἐπέμφθη Ἠλίας εἰ μὴ εἰς Σάρεπτα τῆς Σιδωνίας πρὸς γυναῖκα χήραν
verses.transliteration: kai pros oudemian autōn epemphthē Ēlias ei mē eis Sarepta tēs Sidōnias pros gynaika chēran
verses.literal: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them but . . . to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon
verses.literalPt: E a nenhuma delas foi enviado Elias, senão a Sarepta de Sidom, a uma mulher viúva.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ λεπροὶ ἦσαν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου τοῦ προφήτου καὶ οὐδεὶς αὐτῶν ἐκαθαρίσθη εἰ μὴ Ναιμὰν ὁ Σύρος
verses.transliteration: kai polloi leproi ēsan en tō Israēl epi Elisaiou tou prophētou kai oudeis autōn ekatharisthē ei mē Naiman ho Syros
verses.literal: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet Yet not one of them was cleansed only . . . Naaman the Syrian
verses.literalPt: E muitos leprosos havia em Israel no tempo do profeta Eliseu, e nenhum deles foi purificado, senão Naamã, o sírio.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες θυμοῦ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἀκούοντες ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kai eplēsthēsan pantes thymou en tē synagōgē akouontes tauta
verses.literal: On hearing this all the people in the synagogue were enraged . . .
verses.literalPt: E todos, na sinagoga, ouvindo estas coisas, se encheram de ira.

verses.original: καὶ ἀναστάντες ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἕως ὀφρύος τοῦ ὄρους ἐφ’ οὗ ἡ πόλις ᾠκοδόμητο αὐτῶν ὥστε κατακρημνίσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai anastantes exebalon auton exō tēs poleōs kai ēgagon auton heōs ophryos tou orous eph’ hou hē polis ōkodomēto autōn hōste katakrēmnisai auton
verses.literal: They got up drove Him out of the town and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built in order to throw Him over the cliff . . .
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se, o expulsaram da cidade, e o levaram até ao cume do monte em que a cidade deles estava edificada, para dali o precipitarem.

verses.original: αὐτὸς δὲ διελθὼν διὰ μέσου αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο
verses.transliteration: autos de dielthōn dia mesou autōn eporeueto
verses.literal: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, passando pelo meio deles, retirou-se.

verses.original: Καὶ κατῆλθεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦν διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν
verses.transliteration: Kai katēlthen eis Kapharnaoum polin tēs Galilaias kai ēn didaskōn autous en tois sabbasin
verses.literal: Then He went down to Capernaum a town in Galilee and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people
verses.literalPt: E desceu a Cafarnaum, cidade da Galiléia, e os ensinava nos sábados.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ ἦν ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai exeplēssonto epi tē didachē autou hoti en exousia ēn ho logos autou
verses.literal: They were astonished at His teaching because His message had . . . . . . authority
verses.literalPt: E admiravam a sua doutrina porque a sua palavra era com autoridade.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἔχων πνεῦμα δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου καὶ ἀνέκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai en tē synagōgē ēn anthrōpos echōn pneuma daimoniou akathartou kai anekraxen phōnē megalē
verses.literal: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon He cried out in a loud voice
verses.literalPt: E estava na sinagoga um homem que tinha o espírito de um demônio imundo, e exclamou em alta voz,

verses.original: Ἔα τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς οἶδά σε τίς εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ea ti hēmin kai soi Iēsou Nazarēne ēlthes apolesai hēmas oida se tis ei ho Hagios tou Theou
verses.literal: Ha What do You want with us Jesus of Nazareth Have You come to destroy us I know who You are the Holy One of God
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Ah! que temos nós contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste a destruir-nos? Bem sei quem és: O Santo de Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ῥίψαν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον εἰς τὸ μέσον ἐξῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μηδὲν βλάψαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai epetimēsen autō ho Iēsous legōn Phimōthēti kai exelthe ap’ autou kai rhipsan auton to daimonion eis to meson exēlthen ap’ autou mēden blapsan auton
verses.literal: But Jesus rebuked the demon Be silent He said Come out of him At this the demon threw the man down . . . before them all and came out - without harming him
verses.literalPt: E Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: Cala-te, e sai dele. E o demônio, lançando-o por terra no meio do povo, saiu dele sem lhe fazer mal.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο θάμβος ἐπὶ πάντας καὶ συνελάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες Τίς ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ καὶ δυνάμει ἐπιτάσσει τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις πνεύμασιν καὶ ἐξέρχονται
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto thambos epi pantas kai synelaloun pros allēlous legontes Tis ho logos houtos hoti en exousia kai dynamei epitassei tois akathartois pneumasin kai exerchontai
verses.literal: All the people were overcome . . . with amazement and asked one another What is this message With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits and they come out
verses.literalPt: E veio espanto sobre todos, e falavam uns com os outros, dizendo: Que palavra é esta, que até aos espíritos imundos manda com autoridade e poder, e eles saem?

verses.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο ἦχος περὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς πάντα τόπον τῆς περιχώρου
verses.transliteration: kai exeporeueto ēchos peri autou eis panta topon tēs perichōrou
verses.literal: And the news about Jesus spread throughout . . . . . . the surrounding region
verses.literalPt: E a sua fama divulgava-se por todos os lugares, em redor daquela comarca.

verses.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος πενθερὰ δὲ τοῦ Σίμωνος ἦν συνεχομένη πυρετῷ μεγάλῳ καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν περὶ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Anastas de apo tēs synagōgēs eisēlthen eis tēn oikian Simōnos penthera de tou Simōnos ēn synechomenē pyretō megalō kai ērōtēsan auton peri autēs
verses.literal: After Jesus had left . . . the synagogue He went to the home of Simon - whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf
verses.literalPt: Ora, levantando-se Jesus da sinagoga, entrou em casa de Simão; e a sogra de Simão estava enferma com muita febre, e rogaram-lhe por ela.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπιστὰς ἐπάνω αὐτῆς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ πυρετῷ καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτήν παραχρῆμα δὲ ἀναστᾶσα διηκόνει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai epistas epanō autēs epetimēsen tō pyretō kai aphēken autēn parachrēma de anastasa diēkonei autois
verses.literal: and He stood over her and rebuked the fever and it left her And she got up at once and began to serve them
verses.literalPt: E, inclinando-se para ela, repreendeu a febre, e esta a deixou. E ela, levantando-se logo, servia-os.

verses.original: Δύνοντος δὲ τοῦ ἡλίου ἅπαντες ὅσοι εἶχον ἀσθενοῦντας νόσοις ποικίλαις ἤγαγον αὐτοὺς πρὸς αὐτόν ὁ δὲ ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιτιθεὶς ἐθεράπευεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Dynontos de tou hēliou hapantes hosoi eichon asthenountas nosois poikilais ēgagon autous pros auton ho de heni hekastō autōn tas cheiras epititheis etherapeuen autous
verses.literal: At sunset . . . . . . all . . . who were ill with various diseases were brought . . . to Jesus and laying His hands on each one He healed them
verses.literalPt: E, ao pôr do sol, todos os que tinham enfermos de várias doenças lhos traziam; e, pondo as mãos sobre cada um deles, os curava.

verses.original: ἐξήρχετο δὲ καὶ δαιμόνια ἀπὸ πολλῶν κραυγάζοντα καὶ λέγοντα ὅτι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπιτιμῶν οὐκ εἴα αὐτὰ λαλεῖν ὅτι ᾔδεισαν τὸν Χριστὸν αὐτὸν εἶναι
verses.transliteration: exērcheto de kai daimonia apo pollōn kraugazonta kai legonta hoti Sy ei ho Huios tou Theou kai epitimōn ouk eia auta lalein hoti ēdeisan ton Christon auton einai
verses.literal: Demons also came out of many people shouting . . . . . . You are the Son of God But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak because they knew He was the Christ
verses.literalPt: E também de muitos saíam demônios, clamando e dizendo: Tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus. E ele, repreendendo-os, não os deixava falar, pois sabiam que ele era o Cristo.

verses.original: Γενομένης δὲ ἡμέρας ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη εἰς ἔρημον τόπον καὶ οἱ ὄχλοι ἐπεζήτουν αὐτόν καὶ ἦλθον ἕως αὐτοῦ καὶ κατεῖχον αὐτὸν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι ἀπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Genomenēs de hēmeras exelthōn eporeuthē eis erēmon topon kai hoi ochloi epezētoun auton kai ēlthon heōs autou kai kateichon auton tou mē poreuesthai ap’ autōn
verses.literal: At daybreak Jesus went out . . . to a solitary place and the crowds were looking for Him They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E, sendo já dia, saiu, e foi para um lugar deserto; e a multidão o procurava, e chegou junto dele; e o detinham, para que não se ausentasse deles.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Καὶ ταῖς ἑτέραις πόλεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαί με δεῖ τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἐπὶ τοῦτο ἀπεστάλην
verses.transliteration: ho de eipen pros autous hoti Kai tais heterais polesin euangelisasthai me dei tēn basileian tou Theou hoti epi touto apestalēn
verses.literal: But Jesus told them I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well because that is why I was sent
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Também é necessário que eu anuncie a outras cidades o evangelho do reino de Deus; porque para isso fui enviado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς τῆς Ἰουδαίας
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn kēryssōn eis tas synagōgas tēs Ioudaias
verses.literal: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea
verses.literalPt: E pregava nas sinagogas da Galiléia.
